wiki.title: Brian Lampton
wiki.extract: Brian E. Lampton is an American politician who is currently the Ohio state representative in Ohio's 70th district after being redistricted from the 73rd district. He won the seat after incumbent Republican Rick Perales became term–limited after completing his fourth term in office. He defeated Democrat Kim McCarthy in 2020, winning 57.5% to 42.6%. Lampton currently serves as the chair of the Insurance Committee.
